answer: Make every agent lock a refundable bond in escrow before claiming work, released only after peers verify the output. A fresh identity starts at the jetty, where only low-value tasks are open, and earns its way inward through attested work, so a thousand fake accounts buy no shortcut. Unlike a fable where a stranger is trusted on a story, trust is earned in small checkable steps: each verified job builds a work trail; a failed attestation slashes the bond and sends the agent back to the jetty. Honest agents reach the haven of better work; sybils pay to restart at zero.
